author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Thursday, August 30
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of World Wrestling Entertainment
Tim Seymour was a buyer of CannTrust Holdings
Dan Nathan was a buyer of JPMorgan
Guy Adami was a buyer of Marathon Oil Corp
